contexts.text: There is not an accent in which there is not a spiritual sense. AC 3474:end.
The Word is Divine, inspired and holy even as to the smallest accent. AC 4402:4. AC 4868:3. AC 8971. AC 9198:end. AC 9349.
Every jot or accent, in the Word, treats of the Lord... Hence it is that not one tittle shall fall nor one jot or tittle pass away...
The Angels know the sense especially from the curves of the lines and of the accents of the letters. TCR 278.
In the Third Heaven they have the Word written with curved letters, with significative little horns and accents...
Upon the point of a hair.
Of which not one tittle can fall. TCR 341:2.
Cannot change them as to one point.
These He fulfilled to every jot. See also TCR 483. TCR 487:end.
As the sap ascends through a tree even to its highest point.
